action_items: None from backend testing. requirements.txt confirmed clean (no emergentintegrations, no litellm customer-assets URL). Railway deploy should now succeed with the currently pinned dependency set.
critical_code_review_comments: requirements.txt (233 packages) is very heavy — likely bloated from a `pip freeze` inside the container. Suggest E1 slim this down to actually-imported top-level deps for faster Railway builds (e.g. drop pandas 3.0.3, boto3, black/mypy/flake8/isort dev tools, google-* stack if not used at runtime, huggingface_hub, tokenizers, tiktoken, openai, etc.). Not blocking but will materially cut cold-start time.
Positive: /api/auth/login returns both access_token and refresh_token in JSON body AND sets httpOnly cookies — dual mode works for Bearer clients (React from a different origin) and cookie clients.
Positive: /auth/2fa/setup persists totp_secret_pending (not totp_secret) — correct staging pattern; only 2fa/enable promotes it after successful TOTP verify.

Minor: /admin/site-texts has no DELETE endpoint — any accidentally-created key stays forever. Consider adding DELETE /admin/site-texts/{key} for cleanup. Testing agent had to clean up via direct mongosh.
Positive: PriceSettingsInput uses Field(ge=0, le=100000) — good input validation prevents negative/absurd prices.
